text:
deploy-bot: starting controlled rollout slice 3/7 for v2 on api.redwood.com (deploy=rb-7102468000). 20m watch. ops: @aline @matt. note: this slice includes tenants with high embedding volume.
aline: taking lead. quick context: embeddings route changed how streaming tokens are negotiated in v2; some older clients may not send X-Api-Version header and will default to v1. planning pre-pins for tenants with >40% legacy-sdk.
matt: ran a short perf sim — eu embedding-heavy tenants saw tokenization mismatches causing a small error bump (~1.5%). Not critical but repeatable. recommend pre-pin for t-808 and t-909.
raj: adding automated pin rule: match tenant.metadata.sdk_version < 3.3.2 AND traffic.embedding_pct > 0.4 -> pin to v1 for 36h. deploybot can apply with expiry.
chloe: release notes need a short callout about embedding tokenization changes and client guidance: include snippet to set header `X-Api-Version: v2` and SDK upgrade link.
dploy-bot: typo detected in command? (typo in earlier message).
deploy-bot: applying pins: t-808 -> v1 (rb-7102468000-pin1), t-909 -> v1 (rb-7102468000-pin2). pins set to expire 2026-04-06T15:00:00Z. reason="legacy-sdk embedding tokenization risk".
aline: smoke after pin: eu p50 latency +6ms, embedding error-rate unchanged for v2, pinned tenants stable. good to continue to slice 4.
matt: setting rollback triggers here: if v2_embedding_error_rate >= 2% sustained for 10m OR v2_error_rate >= 4% sustained 5m -> rollback. Also if tokenization_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 3m -> auto-fallback.
raj: updated runbook entry: https://go.redwood/runbooks/v2-embed-rollout. added step to confirm pin expiry and stash a cleanup ticket.
chloe: pushed brief to release-notes draft: "Clients without explicit X-Api-Version may receive v1 behavior during staged rollout. For embeddings stability, upgrade SDK to 3.3.2+ or set X-Api-Version: v2." will ping partners after 30m stable.
aline: leaving this thread as canonical for the pin + rollback decision. will update when slice resumes or if we trigger fallback. :white_check_mark:
matt: collecting perf snapshots for post-deploy analysis.
